heading: SGB 2019-20 Series VI: Understanding Premature Redemption Gains
tldr: Sovereign Gold Bond (SGB) 2019-20 Series VI is currently open for premature redemption, offering significant returns to eligible investors.
The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has set the premature redemption price at ₹14,213 per gram for this series.
Investors who purchased at the original issue price of ₹3,840 per gram stand to realise capital gains of approximately 270% on their initial investment.
These substantial gains are in addition to the fixed interest payments received semi-annually throughout the bond's holding period.
Understanding the tax implications for these capital gains is crucial for investors considering premature redemption.
caption:
Did you invest in Sovereign Gold Bonds (SGB) 2019-20 Series VI? Good news! If you bought at ₹3,840, you could get ₹14,213 per gram now, a huge 270% profit, plus interest you already received. This is a big gain for many. Learn more about what this means for your money and taxes by reading our full article.
